data.title: Monaco vs LOSC Lille Prediction & Betting Tip | 25 Oct 2026
data.content: Good news is the return of forward Paris Brunner (5/4), who missed the last two league games due to suspension. He also scored against Freiburg and is in excellent condition. Defender Eric Dier (6/1) and midfielder Stanis Idumbo (5/1) are injured, while Monaco have plenty of attacking solutions with Ansu Fati, Takumi Minamino and Matthis Abline available. [...] Defender Tiago Santos (6/2) and forwards Ayase Ueda (4/2) & Hamza Igamane (0/0) are injured for Lille, while winger Osame Sahraoui (4/0) is doubtful to play. Despite these problems, they still have enough attacking quality with Olivier Giroud, Soriba Diaoune and Dilane Bakwa. [...] Lille drew 1:1 at home against Brest last weekend and remained close to the top positions. However, their Champions League campaign is going badly, as they lost 3:0 away to Arsenal and then 2:4 at home against Galatasaray on Wednesday. They showed serious defensive weaknesses against the Turkish side, although forward Soriba Diaoune scored twice.
